about.description: DRAMB is an ETF perpetual listed on Delta Exchange India, tracking Roundhill Memory ETF, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Delta Exchange India prices this market off the Binance bStock token for Roundhill Memory ETF, a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
